title: Rinconada Garden-Plot Renovation
description: Complete overhaul for a near-delinquent garden plot at Rinconada Community Garden, from grassy space to pristine canvas!
review: Cal and Fynn did a spectacular job cleaning up my garden plot, I love that I was able to put those old boards to great use!
seoTitle: Garden Plot Renovation Palo Alto | CFC Design build Services
seoDescription: Professional garden plot renovation at Rinconada Community Garden. From overgrown to pristine - see our complete transformation process.

content.text: When Sarah contacted us about her Rinconada Community Garden plot, it had been neglected for months. Weeds had taken over, old materials were scattered around, and the soil structure needed complete rehabilitation. Our goal was to transform this space into a productive, beautiful garden plot while reusing as many existing materials as possible.

before.alt: Overgrown garden plot with weeds and scattered materials
before.caption: Before: Overgrown and neglected community garden plot

after.alt: Clean, organized garden plot with neat rows and pathways
after.caption: After: Pristine garden plot ready for planting

content.text: We started by clearing all vegetation and assessing the existing materials. The old wooden boards were in surprisingly good condition, so we cleaned and repurposed them for new raised bed borders. We then amended the soil with organic compost and created clear pathways for easy access to all planting areas.

title: Raised 4x8 Backyard Redwood Garden Box
description: Custom-built 4x8 raised garden bed using premium redwood lumber, perfect for growing vegetables and herbs in a compact backyard space.
review: The garden box is absolutely perfect! The craftsmanship is excellent and it fits our space beautifully. Already planning our spring plantings!
seoTitle: Custom 4x8 Redwood Garden Box Mountain View | CFC Construction
seoDescription: Professional redwood raised garden bed construction in Mountain View. Custom 4x8 design perfect for vegetables and herbs. Quality craftsmanship guaranteed.

content.text: Mike wanted a raised garden bed that would maximize growing space while fitting perfectly in his compact backyard. We designed a 4x8 foot bed using premium redwood lumber, with 12-inch height for optimal root depth and excellent drainage.

We used 2x12 redwood boards for the walls, with galvanized corner brackets for added strength. The bottom features landscape fabric to prevent weeds while allowing proper drainage. All hardware is stainless steel to prevent corrosion.

images.caption: Premium redwood lumber ready for assembly

images.caption: Finished garden box ready for planting

title: Sand & Stain Redwood Table Rejuvenation
description: Professional restoration of a weathered redwood patio table, bringing it back to life with careful sanding and premium stain application.
review: I can't believe this is the same table! It looks brand new and the stain color is exactly what I wanted. Great attention to detail.
seoTitle: Redwood Table Restoration Palo Alto | Wood Furniture Refinishing
seoDescription: Expert redwood table sanding and staining services in Palo Alto. Professional furniture restoration that brings weathered wood back to life.

content.text: Jennifer's redwood table had been exposed to Bay Area weather for several years without protection. The surface was gray and weathered, with some minor cracking and staining. Our assessment showed the underlying wood was still in excellent condition and perfect for restoration.

before.alt: Weathered gray redwood table before restoration
before.caption: Before: Weathered and gray from years of exposure

after.alt: Beautiful restored redwood table with rich stain
after.caption: After: Rich, protected redwood finish

content.text: We started with careful sanding using progressively finer grits to remove the weathered surface and reveal fresh wood underneath. After thorough cleaning, we applied a premium redwood stain that enhances the natural grain while providing UV protection for years to come.

title: Raised 5x6 Redwood Garden Box & 600lb Boulder Move
description: Custom 5x6 redwood raised garden bed construction combined with professional relocation of a 600-pound decorative boulder to create perfect garden focal point.
review: CFC tackled both the garden box and the massive boulder move with such professionalism. The final result exceeded our expectations completely!
seoTitle: Custom Garden Box & Boulder Moving Los Altos | CFC Landscaping
seoDescription: Professional 5x6 redwood garden box construction and 600lb boulder relocation in Los Altos. Expert landscaping services for unique garden projects.

content.text: David contacted us with an interesting project: he wanted a custom 5x6 garden bed, but there was a 600-pound decorative boulder in the perfect spot. Instead of working around it, we proposed relocating the boulder to create a stunning focal point adjacent to the new garden bed.

Moving a 600-pound boulder requires specialized equipment and careful planning. We used professional moving dollies and leverage techniques to safely relocate the boulder without damaging the surrounding landscape or nearby plants.

title: Six Replacement Custom Window-Sill Planters
description: Precision-crafted replacement window-sill planters, custom-sized to fit perfectly and built with cedar for longevity and natural beauty.
review: Each planter fits like it was made for that exact window - because it was! Beautiful craftsmanship and the cedar will age perfectly.
seoTitle: Custom Window-Sill Planters Menlo Park | Cedar Planter Boxes
seoDescription: Custom-built cedar window-sill planters in Menlo Park. Precision-crafted replacement planters designed for perfect fit and lasting beauty.

content.text: Lisa's home had six different window sizes, each requiring a perfectly fitted planter. We measured each window sill individually and created custom templates to ensure every planter would fit exactly right with proper drainage and stability.

We chose premium cedar for its natural weather resistance and beautiful aging characteristics. Each planter features drainage holes, removable liners for easy plant changes, and subtle mounting brackets for secure installation.

Installation required careful attention to ensure each planter was level and securely mounted. We used stainless steel hardware and added weather stripping where needed to protect both the planters and the window frames.

title: Side Yard Extreme Pruning & Renovation
description: Complete transformation of an overgrown side yard through strategic pruning, plant removal, and landscape restructuring to create usable outdoor space.
review: I never thought this side yard could be salvaged! CFC turned what was basically a jungle into a beautiful, usable space. Amazing work!
seoTitle: Side Yard Renovation Redwood City | Extreme Pruning Services
seoDescription: Professional side yard renovation and extreme pruning in Redwood City. Transform overgrown landscapes into beautiful, usable outdoor spaces.

content.text: Robert's side yard had been neglected for years, with plants growing far beyond their intended boundaries. Shrubs had reached 12+ feet in height, blocking windows and creating dark, unusable space. Our plan involved strategic removal and aggressive pruning to reclaim the area.

before.alt: Extremely overgrown side yard with tall shrubs blocking windows
before.caption: Before: Completely overgrown and unusable side yard

after.alt: Clean, well-maintained side yard with properly sized plants
after.caption: After: Clean, open space with appropriately sized plantings

content.text: Rather than removing everything, we identified which plants could be salvaged through pruning and which needed complete removal. The result is a sustainable landscape that will be much easier to maintain while providing year-round visual interest.

title: Quadruple-Door Squirrel Excluder
description: Innovative custom solution to prevent squirrels from accessing bird feeders while maintaining easy access for birds and homeowner maintenance.
review: This is genius! The squirrels can't figure it out but the birds love it. Plus it looks great in our garden. Very creative solution!
seoTitle: Custom Squirrel-Proof Bird Feeder Palo Alto | Wildlife Solutions
seoDescription: Innovative quadruple-door squirrel excluder for bird feeders in Palo Alto. Custom wildlife control solutions that work for both birds and homeowners.

content.text: Patricia loves feeding birds but was frustrated by persistent squirrels that would empty her feeders in minutes. Traditional squirrel-proof feeders hadn't worked, and she wanted a solution that would look attractive in her garden while being completely effective.

Our solution uses a quadruple-door system with weight-activated mechanisms. When a squirrel's weight is detected, all four doors close simultaneously. Birds, being much lighter, can access the feeder normally. The system is completely mechanical - no electricity required.

Since installation, the feeder has been completely squirrel-free while maintaining full bird access. The cedar construction matches Patricia's garden aesthetic perfectly, and the easy-fill design makes maintenance simple. Even the most determined squirrels have given up!

I've tried everything - spinning feeders, cages, different locations. This is the first solution that actually works 100% of the time. The birds are happy and the squirrels have moved on to someone else's yard!
content.author: Patricia Williams
